result:
I added a `created_at` column as the last column of the CSV that `toCsv` produces in `src/exports/csvExport.ts`. Each value is the row's `createdAt` written as an ISO 8601 string, for example `2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z`. I didn't run the code or any tests.

I used `toISOString()` because `createdAt` is a `Date`. Plain `String(date)` would give a locale-style string that is harder to parse. `toISOString()` throws on an invalid `Date`, so a row with a bad `createdAt` will now make the export fail.
